# opnsense_monit_service (Data Source)

Services monitored by Monit (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ Service Settings**), each checked against a set of tests.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Monit service.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address to check, for `host` services.
- `depends` (Set of String) UUIDs of the services this one depends on.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this service is monitored.
- `interface` (String) Interface to check, for `network` services.
- `match` (String) Process name pattern, for `process` services without a PID file.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the service.
- `path` (String) Path to monitor, or the script for `custom` services.
- `pidfile` (String) PID file of the process, for `process` services.
- `polltime` (String) Polling interval, e.g. `every 2 cycles`.
- `start` (String) Command used to start the service.
- `start_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for the service to start.
- `stop` (String) Command used to stop the service.
- `tests` (Set of String) UUIDs of the tests applied to this service.
- `timeout` (Number) Script timeout in seconds, for `custom` services.
- `type` (String) What is monitored.
